title: Overdue
description: There are multiple new entities in your world, it wants revenge, it wants rent. Must use the rescource pack to play.
body:
# Overdue

Overdue is a Forge horror mod for Minecraft 1.20.1.

Explore haunted structures, trigger cursed events, and try to survive the things that follow you after you make the wrong choice.

## Features

- The Landlord, a hostile stalker entity that hunts players after they open a Haunted Chest
- Bob, a strange companion who can help you, protect you, and become something much worse
- The Banished, a cursed villager found inside a mountain cave
- The Cursed Villager, created when the Banished is pushed too far
- Haunted Rental structure
- Banished Cave structure
- Haunted Chest loot and scare event
- Attic Key and locked attic trapdoor
- Custom sounds, chase music, jumpscares, and horror messages
- New advancements and death messages

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge
- GeckoLib

Install GeckoLib with this mod or it will not work.
